description:
Download Persean Separatists

Download Persean Separatists (Patreon Mirror)

Requires LazyLib 3.0.0

Requires MagicLib 1.5.6

Optional integration:

LunaLib 2.0.5 (for in-game config options and version checking)

Illustrated.Entities (colonies are setup to use selected IE images if availabe)

This mod adds two new factions, one large one small. All content added totaling in at 43 new ships, 57 new weapons, 11 new fighters, and a small number of discoverable locations and quests.

Persean Separatists
A collection of idealists, wayward spacers, and rejects from other factions, the Persean Separatists represent a final effort to control ones own destiny or die trying. Though comparable to the League, the Separatists have banded together under one governing body and purport to uphold a vaguely democratic system. In reality, with the possible exception of the capital of Sedna, harsh conditions mean the colonies operate much more like a mercenary fleet, with leaders strictly followed and only occasionally deposed after a pronounced failure.

As the story goes, the Separatists rose out of a mercenary group, who at the command of their leader, took control of the Koit system for themselves. Evidently fed up with the older factions ever ponderous nature, the commander formally created a government with himself as its head.

Dusk Research Group
The Dusk Research Group is the remnant of a clandestine pre-collapse organization that specialized in exotic, risky, and potentially useless R&D projects. After the fall of the Domain, excess resources became a luxury which swiftly put an end to the formal operation as such and most of its personnel were absorbed by Tri-Tachyon. However the more determined (and unhinged) members took what they could and formed DRG in its modern incarnation. Far away from the Core they restored an old facility on the planet Dusk, which became their new home of operations, as well as their namesake.

Miscellaneous:
Main Github Repo
The Patreon mirror also contains the .blend files for almost every ship and weapon, should you want to make use of them in some way.

Change Log
v0.9.0b:
- Fixed crash related to Asteroid Cutter hullmod
- Improved functionality for adding faction mid-save
- Fixed command missile codex entries appearing in every category
- Fixed Lunalib change log for in-game display

v0.9.0a:
- Fixed loading error related to version_files.csv
- Added mod thread id to version file
- Added Lunalib change log for in-game display

v0.9.0:
- Initial release.

License statement:
All content, such as code, graphics, and writing in this mod made by me (Contractor) is fully released into, and shall be considered in, the public domain.

Anyone is free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or
distribute the public contents of this mod, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, and by any means.

Disclaimer: Despite not being fully finished, this mod is unlikely to supported (by me) long term, though most of the content is implemented, with some quests being the main absences. Unfortunately, after spending multiple years working on this, I have neither the time nor patience to continue, hence it is being distributed now.
As indicated by the license, when I stop maintaining this, anyone is free to take over, should they desire.
